title: Answer: no one is phenomenally conscious, and the illusion depends on introspective capacities

statements.text: No system is phenomenally conscious in the strong sense. Humans are conscious in the inclusive sense, and any system with functionally identical introspective mechanisms, including a zombie or a suitably built robot, would be too. Animals such as dogs share a benign user illusion but, not being theorists, not the theorists’ illusion behind the hard problem.

sources.quote: there is something it is like to be a zombie, since zombies have introspective mechanisms functionally identical to our own
The hard problem and meta-problem are only problems for us humans
